scenarios.name: Corrupted Source Ciphertext
scenarios.injection: Tampered byte in legacy v2 ciphertextHex
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Decryption fails at DECRYPTED state with authentication tag mismatch; source record preserved untouched.

scenarios.name: Dry-Run Simulation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Executes stages 1-5 (VERIFIED); does not commit stage 6 to database; returns candidate envelope.

scenarios.name: Idempotent Re-migration of v3 Record
scenarios.injection: Feed already-migrated v3_kms_gcm record into migration engine
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Detects sourceVersion === targetVersion; skips re-encryption; returns COMMITTED in <1ms.

scenarios.name: Heterogeneous Envelope Batch
scenarios.injection: Batch contains mix of v2_aad_gcm, v3_kms_gcm, and corrupt record
scenarios.expectedBehavior: v2 migrated to v3; v3 skipped; corrupt isolated as FAILED; batch summary reflects partial success without halting whole batch.

scenarios.name: KMS Unavailable During Wrap
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Catches error at WRAPPED state; zeroizes candidate DEK in RAM; source record remains at legacy version.

scenarios.name: Vector Length Inconsistency During Pre-Commit Drill
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Pre-commit drill asserts rawVector.length === decrypted.length; aborts commit if delta detected.

scenarios.name: Process Crash Before Lease Release
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Distributed lease in Firestore has 60-second TTL; automatically clears upon expiry; subsequent retry succeeds.
